name: Ironworker Bryn

intro.text: Merthyr iron went into bridges, rails and railways across half the world. And into a lot of cannon. I make what Merthyr makes: noise. Fancy a go?

win: You've got a decent temper on you. Tempered, that is.
after: Cyfarthfa's blast furnaces lit up the night sky red. People said Merthyr was the only town that didn't need streetlamps.
